confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from an RBA search result that quoted 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026. Food and drink anchors come from aggregator and crowdsourced sources that disagree widely. Cappuccino was about $2.3-3.5, local draft beer about $2-3, an inexpensive meal about $9-25, and a mid-range dinner for two about $33-60. A club cocktail was about ARS 14,900 in an older Feb 2025 listing. Argentine peso volatility makes all of these uncertain. Ushuaia is a remote tourist hub that is pricier than the rest of Argentina, so I weighted estimates toward tourist-restaurant levels rather than the lowest aggregator figures. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual relationship to beer, not from direct local data. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates, not checked against listings. Peak-season (July is ski/winter season) pricing is uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against other Argentine tourist destinations such as Bariloche and El Calafate, with Ushuaia adjusted upward for remoteness and its tourism-driven costs.
